verificationNotes: All physical IPv4 addresses and endpoint gateways are ready; routers start without static routes or routing protocols. OSPF process 10 is configured by the supplied original IOS command sequences.

All router transits are explicitly point-to-point, with costs 10 except cost 5 at both ends of R1/R3. LANs remain passive and advertise their connected /24 with default cost 1. Broadcast DR/BDR election and OSPFv3 are outside this lab.

The complete restored topology has six directed Full adjacencies, three Area 0 router LSAs at every router and two remote intra-area LAN routes per router. Expected route metrics are 6 over the direct R1/R3 path and 11 over the other adjacent transit links.
Direct-link failure changes R1/R3 paths to metric 21 through R2; actual traffic and traceroute verify forwarding. Recovery restores direct metric 6 and the complete live guide state.

New bounded OSPF-interface criteria inspect existing packet-derived interface snapshots. Neighbor criteria can optionally bind the peer device and local interface. Route criteria can optionally bind the installed metric, preventing an incorrect LAN or transit cost from earning the routing goal. Older neighbor and route criteria remain valid.

The reference earns six configuration/operational goals only after actual OSPF convergence. Four real echo tests are needed for ten completed tasks. No echo observations, neighbors, LSAs or routes are fabricated.

Packet-event assertions use timestamps because the simulator retains a bounded rolling event buffer. Configuration save comparisons normalize JSON-only undefined placeholders. Re-enabling OSPF membership allows the next default Hello interval before checking reconvergence.

All eight new-lab browser checks and seven catalog checks passed. File scenarios run sequentially with isolated persistent browser profiles. Each case exercises actual IOS configuration, four real 3/3 traffic tests, received Full neighbors/LSDB, metric-6 direct and metric-21 alternate paths, failure-state reload, healthy reload and a fresh completed reference. No page errors or external application requests were observed.

The frozen offline browser HTML, all per-viewport copies, final root index.html and dist/index.html match byte for byte. Light desktop topology and light/dark guides were visually reviewed. No terminal styles or simulation logic changed.
scope: Adds the Single-Area OSPFv2 catalog lab, guide resources, completed reference, documentation and automated validation. No live CML validation is claimed.
